# @uaudio/luna-builder-sdk

> TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for LUNA Add Ons. One `Luna` namespace. Props (`.value`, `.onChange`, `.set`), Collections (`.items`, `.byId`, `.onChange`). Runs inside LUNA (WebSocket, `?port=` on the page URL) or in a browser talking to LUNA on localhost.

Not supported: streaming audio, or live MIDI input. The SDK edits the session (MIDI clips and
notes, audio clips, parameters, transport) and can play live MIDI messages on a track
(`Luna.SendMidi`, `Luna.QwertyMidi`); it has no audio stream in or out and does not receive
live MIDI. For live MIDI input, use Web MIDI (`navigator.requestMIDIAccess()`) in the page.

Start with QUICKSTART, then the API page for the object you are using. Use EVIDENCE when
the engine does something the docs do not say. Use PROTOCOL only for the raw escape hatch.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md): connect, session, props, tracks, controls, clips, effects, markers, chords, workspace, gui, errors, testing.
- [Files](FILES.md): getting a user's file into an Add On. File route (`<input type="file">`, HTML drop, `uploadFile`) vs path route (`chooseFiles`, `onPathDrop`, `importPath`); never mix them. `luna.gui.serveMediaFile(addOnId, path)` turns an audio or video path into a URL the page plays.
- [Recipes](RECIPES.md): eleven Add Ons to ask an agent for, and the SDK each one leans on.
- [Manifest](MANIFEST.md): `manifest.json` fields (`target`, `floating`, `show_with_session`, ...), Add Ons folder, how LUNA loads a page, secrets (`luna.secrets`).
- [Protocol](PROTOCOL.md): verbs, paths, correlation, pushes, error codes, where things live.
- [Evidence](EVIDENCE.md): numbered measured facts about engine behaviour; cite as "fact N".
- [Tree snapshot](tree/luna-3.0.0.15776.json): the shape of the nodes the SDK builds on, for one LUNA build. `ua-builder tree <path>` prints any node's shape; `ua-builder tree --out file.json` snapshots the running build.

## API reference (generated)

- [api/index.md](api/index.md): every exported class, function and type in the Luna namespace.

## Skills (Claude Code)

- skills/create-add-on: ask the target, scaffold, connect, first feature, tests.
- skills/add-feature: wrap an engine path the SDK does not type yet.
- skills/test-add-on: MockEngine fixtures, settled(), live lane rules.
- skills/debug-connection: nothing connects, no pushes, wrong port, reconnect.
- skills/verify-add-on: prove an Add On against a running LUNA from a second client, and check the undo queue.

These five ship as the `ua-luna-builder` plugin (`plugins/ua-luna-builder/`), which also
carries the SDK builds, the `ua-builder` CLI, the add-on-basic and add-on-typescript templates, the examples and
QUICKSTART/FILES/MANIFEST/PROTOCOL/EVIDENCE/RECIPES. Installed as a plugin, run the CLI as
`node <plugin-root>/sdk/cli.js <command>` instead of `npx ua-builder <command>`.

## Rules of thumb

- Await `luna.session()` before touching tracks. Call `track.loadStrip()` before reading gain/pan/mute.
- Nodes outside a session (`luna.gui.main`, `luna.preferences`) need `node.watch()` to follow pushes.
- Touch every control a user edits (fact 78): clicks are one-shot `set()`/`toggle()`, bracketed for you; drags use `Luna.bindRange(input, control)` for `<input type="range">` or `Luna.bindDrag(element, control)` for a div/canvas knob (touch, writes, release, following LUNA except mid-drag); `Luna.bindGesture` is the touch-and-release part alone for your own pointer code.
- DOM that is rebuilt (mixer strips): collect its listeners and bindings in a `Luna.Bindings` (`on`, `add`, `{ bindings }`), `clear()` it at the start of each rebuild, and schedule rebuilds with `whenIdle(render)` so none runs mid-drag.
- Keyboard: inside LUNA, any key the page does not `preventDefault()` goes on to LUNA's own shortcuts (fact 81). Call `Luna.bindShortcuts(luna)` after connecting so undo, redo, play and record also work outside LUNA; inside LUNA it installs nothing (facts 79-81).
- Timeline = ticks (96e9 per beat); source offsets = nanoseconds. No conversion in the SDK.
- Effect bypass is `slot.setIn(bool)`, not the `enabled` property.
- MIDI: `clip.midi.ready()`, then `clip.midi.notes` / `.events` are live lists in clip-relative ticks (`Note.startTick` 0 is the clip's start; add `clip.start.value` for a session tick; `lane.createNotes` takes session ticks but returns clip-relative notes, writes channel 0 only, and makes the clip if none is under the notes; `session.insertClip` needs a `sourceUid`, so it cannot make an empty MIDI clip; facts 111-112). Write with `clip.addNote`/`addNotes` (many notes, one undo step)/`addMidi`. These are clip edits. To play notes live, `const midi = new Luna.SendMidi(luna)`: `sendMidiNote(sessionUid, trackUid, note, velocity, noteOn)`, `sendMidi` (raw 3 bytes), `sendController`, `sendProgramChange`, `sendNoteToTracks`, `sendDeviceNote`, `sendAllNotesOff` (facts 108-109). `new Luna.QwertyMidi(midi)` maps A-; and W-P to notes (Z/X octave, C/V velocity) from `handleKeyDown(e, sessionUid, trackUid)` / `handleKeyUp(e)`; call `releaseAll()` on blur. Live MIDI input comes from Web MIDI, not the SDK.
- TypeScript, React or any bundler: `ua-builder new <name> --template add-on-typescript`. It builds `src/` into one classic IIFE script (`dist/main.js`; Windows blocks module scripts under `file://`), types the `Luna` global through tsconfig `"types": ["@uaudio/luna-builder-sdk/global"]` (do not import the SDK in `src/`), and `npm run pack` builds then packs without sources, source maps, configs or `.env`. `ua-builder pack` refuses a page whose scripts are missing.
- Files (FILES.md): if the page needs the audio, use `<input type="file">` or an HTML `drop`, which give `File`s in LUNA and a browser alike, then `session.uploadFile({ bytes: file })`. `luna.gui.chooseFiles()` and `Luna.onPathDrop()` give **paths the page cannot read**; they only feed `session.importPath(path)` (a source) or `session.importFile(path)` (LUNA's import, with a clip), an optimization that skips copying through the page. Never `chooseFiles` and then try to `fetch` the path. The exception is audio and video: `luna.gui.serveMediaFile(addOnId, path)` answers a URL the page plays (`<video src>`) or reads with XMLHttpRequest (fact 114), which is how an Add On reloads a media file whose path it saved in `session.preferences`. In LUNA 3.1.0.4589 and earlier (macOS) `<input type="file">` opens nothing (its `cancel` fires at once) and path drops stop after the Add On window is reopened (facts 104-105): always offer an HTML drop zone, and `chooseFiles` + `importPath` for paths.
- Secrets (MANIFEST.md, "Secrets"): API keys and tokens go in `luna.secrets.get/set/delete(name)`, which inside LUNA uses the OS keychain scoped to the Add On's `id`; never `localStorage`, IndexedDB, cookies or a file in the Add On. Outside LUNA (`luna.secrets.storage === 'memory'`) values last until reload.
- `/gui` is absent on a headless engine: check `luna.gui.available()`; without it every `luna.gui` command and `importFile` reject with `Luna.Unsupported`.
- Sends are outputs: `channel.outputs.byId('send_0')`, with `assign`/`unassign`/`retarget`/`moveTo`. Assign appends, so use `retarget` to replace (fact 43). Read `send.destinations` (each has the assignment `uid` that `unassign` takes, `busUid`, `name`, `error`), not the raw `assignments` rows (fact 83).
- Pan is `pan` on a mono channel and `pan_left`/`pan_right` on a stereo one (fact 84): use `output.pans` (or `panLeft`/`panRight`); `output.pan` is the left one on stereo.
- Automation values go on the wire as float literals (`Luna.float`), because LUNA stores a bare whole number as 0 (fact 82). `lane.insert`/`setValue`/`move`/`clear` resolve once the lane shows the edit.
- Plugins: `slot.setPlugin(id)` and `channel.insert(id)` resolve once loaded (`slot.loaded`) and reject with the slot's `plugin_error`; list parameters with `slot.params`, which leaves out a cleared plugin's ghosts (fact 86).
- A removed object is disposed: `node.disposed`, `node.onDispose(fn)`; its commands reject with `Luna.Disposed`.
- Bounce/export: `session.bounce({ channelUids, range })` and `session.exportMain()` return a `Render`; watch `render.progress` and `await render.done()` (fact 44).
- Waveforms: `Luna.clipAudio(clip, session.sources)` says which source to draw (the original, or LUNA's time-stretched render); `new Luna.Waveforms().range(source, startNs, stopNs, Luna.kindForScale(nsPerPixel))` pages the pairs; `Luna.audioNsAtTick` maps a tick to a file offset (facts 72-73); `Luna.waveformColumns(range, width, nsAt, { gain })` (LUNA's gain is `session.context.waveformZoom.value` times the clip gain; fact 94) gives one min/max per pixel per channel, reduced as LUNA's timeline does (linear, touching zero, interpolated when zoomed in; fact 93), `Luna.waveformLanes` stacks a lane per channel, so stereo is never folded to one shape, and `Luna.traceWaveform(ctx, channel, lane, x0)` adds LUNA's filled outline to a path. `Luna.waveformPeak(range)` gives the gain to normalize. No analysis means draw an outline, never silence.
- MIDI edits: `midi.setVelocities` (one post, one undo entry), `midi.setMuted`, `midi.deleteNotes`. They move LUNA's selection and put it back (fact 74), and work inside a `transaction()`.
- Transactions: `session.transaction(name, fn)` is a batch, one undo step; rewrite notes there with `midi.deleteNotes(old)` then `clip.addNotes(new)`, and read the lists after it resolves (LUNA holds pushes until the commit). `{ continuous: true }` is a live gesture: each command replaces the one before, so write every step relative to the start; `lane.createNotes` in one regenerates a take and only the last is kept (fact 115). `lane.createNotes` refuses inside a batch.
- Recording: `luna.audioInputs()` lists device inputs; `session.record({ track, inputUid, startTick, seconds })` runs the whole pass and resolves to the finalized take, source listed (facts 75-76).
- `Luna.settle(predicate, what, { refresh })` is how to wait for an edit: LUNA answers `null` whether or not it happened (fact 71).
- Key and chords: `await session.musical.setKeySignature(sharpsAndFlats, isMinor, tick?)` resolves to the row (one per tick, fact 113); `musical.keySignatureAt(tick)` is the key in effect. `Luna.parseChord(name)` splits a chord symbol (lowercase roots accepted).
- Timeline conversions: `tickAtBar`, `tickAt({bar,beat,tick})`, `barBeat(tick)`, `seconds(tick)`, `tickAtSeconds(s)`, `formatBarBeat(tick)`; `timeline.onChange` fires on tempo or meter edits. `barBeat().tick` is engine ticks: pass it to `Luna.formatBarBeat` unconverted. `marker.barBeat` / `marker.seconds` are derived props that follow the marker and the tempo map.
- Folders outside a session (`/renders`, `/jobs`, `/plugins`) need `collection.watch()` before they follow pushes (fact 34).
- Tests: `Luna.MockEngine`, `await engine.settled()`, `await luna.settled()`.

## SDK feedback

When a workflow was harder than the SDK should make it, end your reply with the line
`LUNA BUILDER SDK FEEDBACK: <version>` (the version from `ua-builder doctor`, or
`Luna.VERSION`) followed by a prompt that can be used to update the SDK to support the
improved workflow.
